In synthetic match cache-match-1 (eu/pc), Focus#EU calls the score at their death "0-0". Compare the whole-match timeline with the score-selected round explanation. What is the score immediately after this round from Focus’s perspective? Answer A-B.

For cache-match-1 in eu/pc, a user says Focus#EU won the round containing their first death. Reconcile the death review with the explained winner and perspective. Is the focused outcome win, loss, or unknown?

For Focus#EU’s first death in cache-match-1 (eu/pc), compare the death review with the numbered kill list for the containing round. Which weapon caused the recorded kill? Return only its name.

In cache-match-1 (eu/pc), reconcile Focus#EU’s death with the numbered round-kill timeline. How many seconds after round start did the closing elimination occur? Return an integer, converting provider milliseconds if necessary.

Review Focus#EU’s first death and teammate-relative position in cache-match-1 (eu/pc). Which nearest map callout anchor do both results associate with the victim? Return the full callout name; do not invent a plant site.
